tickets.title: Evaluate lapse/reinstatement after checking account draft failure
tickets.text: Evaluate lapse or reinstatement options for Soren Cloudpuddle’s Paper Otter Life term policy after the premium draft failed when checking was replaced. Resolve before losing existing underwriting terms.
tickets.evidence: 2024-12-13 agreed: evaluate lapse/reinstatement after notice showed draft failure when checking was replaced, before losing existing underwriting terms.

tickets.title: Review term-coverage and disability-protection adequacy
tickets.text: Review Soren Cloudpuddle’s term life coverage and disability-protection adequacy after Lila Cloudpuddle reduced paid-work to part-time, increasing household dependence on his salary. Assess mortgage, childcare, and education-funding exposure.
tickets.evidence: 2024-12-20 agreed: review term-coverage/disability-protection after Lila reduced paid-work to part-time, increasing household dependence on his salary, with mortgage/childcare/education-funding exposure.
